$comment: Perf budgets for the M0 reference scenes (plan §10, ADR-0007). Draw calls include the colour pass, the moon shadow pass, the G-buffer for line art and character outlines. Frame time is measured under SwiftShader in CI, hence the generous ceiling. market-tpp (M2): the Targ district streamed in, Shinsekai streamed out; measured 182 draw calls / 80 active meshes. ADR-0021 (fire escape, balcony, three ladders and roof parapets on the south row): measured 248 draw calls / 109 active meshes. docks (ADR-0024): east end of the quay looking west (water and mist, crane, office), the docks yard and quay streamed in and nothing else; measured 190 draw calls / 82 active meshes. ADR-0026 (Kenta, Fumiko and Goro behind the north stalls, Sachiko at the kiosk, the people of Ulica Kanałowa down the street behind the gate, the car on the deck): measured 301 draw calls / 120 active meshes; the four market keepers alone are 20 draw calls. ADR-0027 (dressing per chunk, bare-structure skins, far city): reference 102 -> 101 draw calls / 34 -> 35 active meshes, street-tpp 211 -> 210 / 81 -> 82, market-tpp 301 -> 304 / 120 -> 123, docks 190 -> 198 / 82 -> 87; budgets unchanged. ADR-0030 (signs, holo-ads and street reflections in one always-active mesh; the gameplay post-process is off the camera while idle): reference 101 -> 102 / 35 -> 36, street-tpp 210 -> 211 / 82 -> 83, market-tpp 304 -> 305 / 123 -> 124, docks 198 -> 199 / 87 -> 88; budgets unchanged. ADR-0036 (wet-asphalt probe renders only on a district change, trail beams and the metro car are disabled while idle): reference 102 / 36 unchanged, docks 211 / 94 after the wave 2 merges; the metro car alone (models=off) 61 / 12; budgets unchanged. ADR-0038 (clinic and Neon Koi interiors, doors, the barman and two regulars; plain interior blocks merged per preset and 64 m cell, no moon shadow; without the merge 152 / 360): reference 132, street-tpp 301 draw calls; budgets raised to 135 and 305. ADR-0041 (sidewalks baked into the chunk dressing, the crowd of residents in one shared mesh with outline, no moon shadow): reference 132 / 47 unchanged, street-tpp 297 -> 301 / 120 -> 121, market-tpp 303 -> 307 / 123 -> 124, docks 227 / 100 unchanged (empty at night); budgets unchanged. ADR-0045 (the game in Lublin; old scenes street-tpp, market-tpp and docks replaced): measured with the test stepping the game (ADR-0046, models=off, SwiftShader), draw calls / active meshes: reference (Neon Koi in its tenement) 179 / 73, krakowskie-tpp (the deptak west of the clinic, walking east) 369 / 156, rynek-tpp (up Bramowa onto the Rynek) 204 / 80, podzamcze-tpp (the market under the viaduct from its east end) 289 / 114, nabrzeze (the quay at night) 266 / 114, phone-low (800x370, quality low, touch, on the deptak) 231 / 145; the same in two runs. Budgets a few percent above. Frame time is reported in reports/perf.json, not checked (ADR-0046). ADR-0048 (Stare Miasto: gate passages lined, the footbridge, bracket signs, Hebi patrols, Trasa Podziemna in a chunk of its own): rynek-tpp 204 / 80 -> 226 / 86 (at 21:01 a Hebi patrol walks the Rynek in view, 4 meshes, and the TRASA PODZIEMNA sign over the Trybunal's door, 2; the cellars stream in only near the Trybunal, with them in the Rynek's chunk it was 262 / 104); budget 210 / 84 -> 232 / 90; the other scenes unchanged. ADR-0049 (80 degrees across instead of ~94 at 16:9, TPP 2.2 m at eye height instead of 2.7 m, the reference camera 1.15 m further back to keep its framing): measured the same way in two runs, draw calls / active meshes before -> after: reference 179 / 73 -> 167 / 67, krakowskie-tpp 369 / 156 -> 359 / 151, rynek-tpp 204 / 80 -> 187 / 71, podzamcze-tpp 289 / 114 -> 256 / 96, nabrzeze 266 / 114 -> 226 / 95, phone-low 231 / 145 -> 227 / 141. Budgets lowered to a few percent above. Merged (ADR-0048 + ADR-0049): rynek-tpp measured 209 / 77 with the patrol and the Trasa sign in the narrower view; budget 215 / 81. ADR-0050 (street furniture in the game baked per 256 m block with one halo mesh for the city, the crowd at 32/18/6 per chunk drawn to 90/70/40 m, the traffic in one shared mesh and the parked cars in another): measured with the same steps, draw calls / active meshes before -> after: reference 167 / 67 -> 178 / 73, krakowskie-tpp 357 / 151 -> 375 / 159, rynek-tpp 209 / 77 -> 221 / 84, podzamcze-tpp 256 / 96 -> 275 / 105, nabrzeze 224 / 94 -> 230 / 97, phone-low 226 / 141 -> 232 / 147. Of the new meshes 6 to 7 are the furniture (near blocks, far blocks, halos), 1 the vehicles, 1 the parked cars; the furniture as thin instances per kind (ADR-0047) cost 17 to 20 meshes on the deptak (15 draw calls more than now). Budgets a few percent above. ADR-0051 (vertical Lublin 2077: superstructures, wall clutter, cables, footbridges and ads baked into the existing cell meshes; the skyline of corporate towers as two impostor meshes, 3 draw calls with the G-buffer; mist only down the busy canyons, so the Rynek's cells need no new sign mesh for it): measured on top of ADR-0049, before -> after, draw calls / active meshes: reference 167 / 67 -> 170 / 69, krakowskie-tpp 359 / 151 -> 363 / 154, rynek-tpp 209 / 77 -> 218 / 83, podzamcze-tpp 256 / 96 -> 261 / 100, nabrzeze 224 / 94 -> 228 / 97, phone-low 227 / 141 -> 228 / 142 (low: no tower lights). Only rynek-tpp went over its budget: 215 / 81 -> 225 / 87; the others stay within theirs. Merged with the outdoor steps and the lamp shafts on the map's ground: podzamcze-tpp 262 / 101 (one mesh over), budget 263 / 100 -> 270 / 104. Merged ADR-0050 + ADR-0051 (furniture, crowd and traffic with vertical Lublin), measured: reference 183 / 76, krakowskie-tpp 379 / 162, rynek-tpp 232 / 90, podzamcze-tpp 281 / 110, nabrzeze 235 / 101, phone-low 233 / 148 (ADR-0050 alone: 178 / 73, 375 / 159, 221 / 84, 275 / 105, 230 / 97, 232 / 147). Over budget and raised a few percent above: rynek-tpp 228 / 87 -> 239 / 93, podzamcze-tpp 283 / 109 -> 290 / 113, nabrzeze 232 / 99 -> 242 / 104; the others stay within theirs. Streaks of the game's own neon and lamps on the map's ground (Atmosphere.addReflection put every streak at y = 0.03 whatever the ground; under the viaduct the market lies some 12 m below the map's anchor, so its five streaks hung in the air out of view) and lights hidden behind buildings out of the glow layer: podzamcze-tpp 281 / 110 -> 286 / 115 in two runs, the other scenes unchanged; activeMeshes budget 113 -> 118.
